title: Ammonia smell and staining inside the Red Pyramid

tellings.quote: There's chemical staining all over the walls and an intense smell of ammonia that emanates from the final chamber.

plain: Inside the Red Pyramid, an ancient pyramid at Dahshur in Egypt, there is "chemical staining all over the walls and an intense smell of ammonia" coming from the final chamber, says a researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, who says he went in himself in 2017. Drumm, who says an alien gave him the true purpose of the pyramids, offers it as a sign that the pyramid once served some chemical process rather than as a tomb.
